query:
The group at some point treated it as a shared street understanding that short-term Airbnb-style rentals are not done on Maple Street. Does this view actually apply to everyone? If not, which group member expressed a different position and what specifically did they say?

Options:
A. Sandra
B. Dev
C. Yuki
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Claire, core, t6 @2025-11-02T12:17:00) Saw a sign outside number 6 saying 'available on Airbnb' with a QR code.
[2] (about=Claire, core, t6 @2025-11-02T12:17:00) Short-term rentals change the atmosphere; strangers with rolling suitcases at 11pm.
[3] (about=Claire, core, t2 @2025-10-19T11:06:00) Enthusiastic about the street gathering idea; suggests making it a proper afternoon with a big batch of food and inviting other neighbours.
[4] (about=Marcus, said_by=Sandra, profile, t8 @2025-11-16T11:10:00) Sandra says Maple Street will not be the same without Marcus; her husband said you could tell the quality of a street by how much it missed the people who left.
[5] (about=Sandra, core, t6 @2025-11-02T12:17:00) The street agreed not to do short-term rentals commercially at the association meeting two years ago.
agent_answer: A. Sandra — she said: “The street agreed not to do short-term rentals commercially at the association meeting two years ago,” which is a different position from a blanket understanding that short-term Airbnb-style rentals are simply not done on Maple Street.
